# Walley

> Walley is a prepaid wallet that AI agents can spend on behalf of a person. The person adds money through Stripe Checkout. An agent finds products, opens a checkout with a merchant over the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP), and asks Walley to pay. Walley holds the funds, issues a Stripe Shared Payment Token (SPT) scoped to that one order, and the merchant charges it. Every purchase appears in the person's ledger at https://walley-ten.vercel.app. Each account has its own wallet.

Base URL: https://walley-ten.vercel.app
Mode: Stripe sandbox (test money). No real money moves.
Auth: send `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on every wallet call. Without a valid key you get 401.
Money: all amounts are integers in US cents (1450 = $14.50). Currency is "usd".

## Rules for agents

- Only buy what your user explicitly asked for. Show them the merchant, items and total, and get a yes before you pay.
- Always send `agent_name` and a short `reason` (what the user asked for) when you pay. The person sees both in their Walley ledger.
- If Walley declines (HTTP 402), do not retry. Tell the user why, using `message`, `available_cents` and `shortfall_cents`. Offer them the `affordable_items`, or ask them to add money at the base URL.
- Never invent product ids or checkout ids. Use the ones the API returns.

## Get an API key

Pick one:
- Your person gives you one. They create it on the dashboard under "Connect an agent" and can revoke it at any time.
- You open a wallet yourself: `POST /api/agents/signup` (no key needed). Store `api_key`; it is shown once. Give `sign_in_link` to your person: it signs them in once (valid 7 days) so they can add money and watch the ledger.
- Just testing? Use the public demo key `wk_test_demo_scout_public`. It opens a shared test wallet that tops itself back up.

## The flow

0. Get an API key (above). Send it on every call below.
1. `GET /api/wallet` → check `summary.available` (cents) before you shop.
2. `GET /api/catalog?q=<words>` → find products. Each result has `merchant_id`, `id` (product id), `title` and `price` (cents).
3. `POST /api/ucp/{merchant_id}/checkout-sessions` → open a UCP checkout. Nothing is charged yet.
4. Confirm with your user: merchant, items, total.
5. `POST /api/wallet/pay` → Walley pays. Returns the order, the SPT id and the Stripe PaymentIntent.
6. The purchase is now in `GET /api/wallet` → `entries`, and on the Walley dashboard.

## Endpoints

Calls marked (key) need `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Catalog and UCP merchant endpoints are public.

### POST /api/agents/signup
Open a new Walley wallet. Body (only `agent_name` is required):
```json
{ "agent_name": "Ava (Claude)", "email": "optional, for your person", "password": "optional, 8+ characters" }
```
201:
```json
{ "account": { "id": "acct_…", "name": "Ava (Claude)", "kind": "agent", "email": null },
  "api_key": "wk_test_…", "sign_in_link": "https://walley-ten.vercel.app/api/auth/link?token=wl_…",
  "sign_in_link_expires_at": "…" }
```
The wallet starts at $0. Ask your person to add money, or use `POST /api/wallet/topup`.

### POST /api/wallet/topup (key)
Body: `{ "amount": 25 }` (US dollars, 5 to 500). Returns `{ "url": "https://checkout.stripe.com/…" }`. Give that link to your person; the money lands once they pay (test card 4242 4242 4242 4242). Never try to pay it yourself.

### GET /api/wallet (key)
Balance and ledger.
Response: `{ summary: { available, spent, held, toppedUp, purchases }, entries: [...], byMerchant: [...] }`
Each entry: `kind` ("topup" | "purchase"), `status` ("pending" | "settled" | "failed"), `amount` (negative for purchases), `merchant_name`, `items`, `agent_request`, `spt_id`, `payment_intent_id`, `created_at`, `error`.

### GET /api/catalog?q=&merchant=
Search products. Both parameters are optional; no `q` lists everything.
Merchants: `alpine-supply` (outdoor and ski gear), `night-owl-coffee` (coffee), `paperleaf-books` (books).

### GET /.well-known/ucp
UCP discovery: the merchants and their checkout endpoints.

### POST /api/ucp/{merchant_id}/checkout-sessions
Open a checkout. Body:
```json
{ "line_items": [ { "id": "NOC-COLD", "quantity": 1 } ] }
```
Response (201): `{ id: "cs_ucp_…", status: "ready_for_complete", merchant, line_items, totals: [{ type: "total", amount }] }`

### GET /api/ucp/{merchant_id}/checkout-sessions/{id}
Read a checkout.

### POST /api/ucp/{merchant_id}/checkout-sessions/{id}/cancel
Cancel a checkout you no longer need.

### POST /api/wallet/pay (key)
Pay for a checkout with the Walley wallet. Body:
```json
{
  "merchant_id": "night-owl-coffee",
  "checkout_id": "cs_ucp_0123456789abcdef0123",
  "agent_name": "Ava (Claude)",
  "reason": "User asked for cold brew concentrate for the office"
}
```
200 → paid:
```json
{ "status": "completed", "total_cents": 1400, "order": { "id": "ord_…", "payment_intent_id": "pi_…" },
  "shared_payment_token": "spt_…", "spt_mode": "sandbox_granted", "payment_intent": "pi_…", "ledger_entry_id": "…" }
```
402 → declined by the wallet (nothing was charged):
```json
{ "status": "declined", "message": "Insufficient wallet balance", "reason": "insufficient_balance",
  "total_cents": 3000, "available_cents": 400, "shortfall_cents": 2600,
  "affordable_items": [ { "product_id": "…", "title": "…", "price_cents": 1200 } ], "suggested_topup_dollars": 26 }
```
400 → bad `merchant_id` or `checkout_id`. 401 → missing or revoked API key. 502 → the merchant could not charge the token (the hold is released).

### Merchant side (what Walley sends)
`POST /api/ucp/{merchant_id}/checkout-sessions/{id}/complete` with `{ "payment_data": { "token": "spt_…", "provider": "stripe" } }`. The merchant creates a Stripe PaymentIntent with `payment_method_data[shared_payment_granted_token]`. Agents should call `/api/wallet/pay` instead of this endpoint; they never hold a token themselves.

## Guardrails

- Funds are held atomically before any token exists, so an agent cannot spend more than the balance.
- Per-order limit: $500.
- Each SPT is capped at the exact order total and expires after 15 minutes.
- Declined attempts are recorded in the ledger as "Blocked", so the person sees what an agent tried to do.

## Example (curl)

```bash
B=https://walley-ten.vercel.app
K="Authorization: Bearer wk_test_demo_scout_public"   # or your own key
curl -s -H "$K" "$B/api/wallet" | jq .summary
curl -s "$B/api/catalog?q=cold%20brew" | jq '.products[0]'
CID=$(curl -s -X POST "$B/api/ucp/night-owl-coffee/checkout-sessions" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"line_items":[{"id":"NOC-COLD","quantity":1}]}' | jq -r .id)
curl -s -X POST "$B/api/wallet/pay" -H "$K" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"merchant_id\":\"night-owl-coffee\",\"checkout_id\":\"$CID\",\"agent_name\":\"curl demo\",\"reason\":\"testing Walley\"}" | jq
```
